Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Tom Collins is credited on 31 distinct recordings across 4 programs from 1944-09-11 through 1956-09-26. Documented roles include performer on 31 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are The Adventures of Frank Race (performer on 22 recordings; 22 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), Lux Radio Theatre (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), and X Minus One (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Frank Race (22 portrayals).
